sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def check(r):
    return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def path_to(tr,tc):
    r,c=barpos(); seq=[]
    while (r,c)!=(tr,tc):
        if r<tr: seq.append('DOWN'); r+=4
        elif r>tr: seq.append('UP'); r-=4
        elif c<tc: seq.append('RIGHT'); c+=4
        else: seq.append('LEFT'); c-=4
    return seq
targets=[]
for tr in [12,16,28,40,44]:
    for tc in [20,24,28,32,36,40]:
        targets.append((tr,tc))
print('start',barpos(),'n targets',len(targets))
for (tr,tc) in targets:
    seq=path_to(tr,tc)
    if seq:
        r=action(seq)
    else:
        r=action(['SPACE'])  # trigger a check while already there
    if r.get('game_over'):
        print('GO at',(tr,tc),'now',barpos()); continue
    if check(r):
        print('WIN at',(tr,tc)); break
    # silent ok
print('final',barpos(),'last state',last_action_result.get('state'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
